Question Choices: Select which of the following quadrilaterals have all four sides of equal length?: ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Square | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Which shapes have every side the same?
Solution: A rhombus has four equal sides, and a square does too. Rectangles and trapezoids need not have all four sides equal. Select Rhombus and Square.

Question Choices: How many sides does a hexagon have?
Solution: A hexagon has 6 straight sides. Count each edge once around its boundary.

Question Choices: How many corners does a triangle have?
Hints: Count each point where two sides meet.
Solution: A triangle has 3 points where neighboring sides meet, so it has 3 corners.

Question Choices: Select which shape has all right angles?: ~~Triangle | Square | Circle~~
Hints: A right angle is a 90-degree corner.
Solution: A square has four right angles. A triangle cannot have all right angles, and a circle has no corners. Select Square.

Question Choices: Select all the quadrilaterals: ~~Square | Triangle | Rectangle | Circle | Trapezoid~~
Solution: A quadrilateral has 4 straight sides. Square, Rectangle and Trapezoid each have 4. Triangle has 3 and Circle has none. Select Square, Rectangle and Trapezoid.
